main.description: A saved Placemark map, stored in the user's own PDS repo.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last written, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

data.description: The map's feature data, encoded as FlatGeobuf.

symbolization.description: Placemark's symbolization config. Validated by the app's own Zod schemas, not by this lexicon.

layer.description: The selected base layer, omitted when the map has none. Validated by the app's own Zod schemas, not by this lexicon.

folders.description: Folder tree for organizing features. Validated by the app's own Zod schemas, not by this lexicon.

layerConfigs.description: Configured map layers. Validated by the app's own Zod schemas, not by this lexicon.
